title: Payments
intro: Simple, and confirmed by a person.

sections.title: How ordering works
sections.text: Add pieces to your bag and place your order at checkout. You get an order number straight away. We call you to confirm before we send it, and you pay in cash when it arrives. If you chose bKash or Nagad, we check your Transaction ID before sending.

sections.title: Stay safe
sections.text: Never send money on the strength of a message from an account that is not linked from this website.
